             SET persona = $2, settings = $3, plan = $4, rule_pack_id = $5,
                 rule_pack_version = $6, content_hash = $7, updated_at = $8, updated_by = $9,
                 scenarios = $10, purpose_id = $11, purpose_version = $12
             WHERE agent_id = $1
